purpose: Run repeated, jurisdiction-preserving global evidence orbits that feed M-04B, M-04F, Flock-shape, and Pattern-to-Proof without allowing geographic volume to self-promote.
proof_requirements: Every basin must have all four hydrology classes and an independently executable poll plan.
Every first-orbit bootstrap must emit a basin artifact and a consolidated orbit proof artifact.
Network outputs remain artifacts and candidates; no scheduled job writes canonical findings.
Translation state and source-language tags must remain explicit.
Direct voice cannot be transferred across deployments or jurisdictions.
Cross-border transfer requires sending and receiving records plus a mechanism and local implementation.
improvements_over_wave01: Twelve independently validated basin matrices instead of one undifferentiated global surface.
Host-concentration and route-diversity metrics to expose source monoculture.
Per-basin state, failures, change queues, and success-rate health records.
Consolidated orbit proof requiring the expected basin artifact denominator.
Explicit translation provenance and local-language coverage.
Separate cross-border currents that cannot be closed by similarity alone.
